_doc: xAI Grok SHADOW reader (Keaton 2026-10-16). Informational only: reads B+ or better cards, re-anchored arrays and a once-per-closed-5m RTH missed-setup check, and writes plain-language reads to payload.grokReads + a [grok-reader] log line. NOT part of shared/desk-rules.json (RULES_HASH unchanged). Nothing in gate/score/fire reads it. Off unless env GROK_READER=1 and XAI_API_KEY is set. Calls are fire-and-forget with a hard timeout and are never awaited by the desk build.
